d: This episode of Tarikh revisits the infamous Bloodbath in Jamaica, one of the darkest chapters in cricket history. It tells the story of the 1976 India vs West Indies Test at Sabina Park, Kingston, where Sunil Gavaskar, Anshuman Gaekwad, Bishan Singh Bedi, and the Indian team faced the terrifying pace of Michael Holding, the legendary Whispering Death. From Clive Lloyd’s revenge-driven strategy and brutal bouncers to blood, injuries, and unforgettable courage, this documentary uncovers how the Kingston Test transformed world cricket and established the fearsome legacy of the West Indies…
